evidence: I walked all 2 gate, 44 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria against the frozen golden source. Nearly every leg is covered by the server rules and the UI. Job validation: index.js:202-214 (text() for title and team, a hiring-manager role check, Number.isInteger 1..50), and board.js:72 sends NaN, serialised as null, for 2.5. Email rules: index.js:222-224 refuses with 400/409 tied to the field, and board.js:52-56 keeps the typed name and email. Move rules: index.js:238-265 enforces one stage at a time, reject reason, reopen to the rejected-from stage, no rejecting Hired, and manager own-job late stages. Role checks run before the Interview capacity check (index.js:289-295), so manager replays get 403, not a capacity 409. A stale move gets 409 naming the last actor through the activity detail, e.g. 'Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied' (index.js:241-245). Bulk moves are sorted into board order and all-or-none in one immediate transaction (index.js:284-320). Undo restores each card by index, refuses on a version conflict or a full Interview, works once and only for the latest action (index.js:348-373, 165-168). I traced protocol B steps 1-15 and the L and M undo legs. Each expected order is produced (Y,W,X; Y,W,X,Z,A2; A2,V), and neither a note nor a change to another card bumps A2's version. Replay statuses 401/403/404/409 match R/T/C (auth(), mayMove, staffOnly, application()). The candidate read model carries only title, team, status wording and thread summary (index.js:171-176), and the SSE stream carries no data. Activity is written per card, newest first, filterable by job, and rolled back with any refused action. Moves are shown at once, put back from a snapshot if refused, and focus goes to the card's select (board.js:166-205). Conversations: paging is 30 at a time with earlier_count and the reader's place kept (threads.js:160-175); arrival while scrolled up shows a pill and does not mark read (threads.js:152-158). Drafts are kept per user and per thread in localStorage, and a 401 calls sessionLost to ask for sign-in again (app.js:34, 39-43, 189-195). Seeding is guarded by the user count. The seed figures match protocol Z: Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco and Screen Priya/Samuel; Noor's note text; Lena has read 2 of 3 and the 3rd is from USR-REC3, so she has 1 unread. Raw evidence: the hash-verified 8 Oct scripted golden run passed 26 groups, including live board arrival at 798 ms. Its own scope says it does not walk every Functional criterion as the judge would. No configured judge run or Oracle score exists. DEFECT in hro_unread_counts (weight 2), leg 'while it is open at its newest message Tomas's next message does not raise his count or total'. When the message arrives, app.js refresh() calls render(). render() calls the threads update(), which starts the async catchUp(). In the same render() pass, the nav total badge is painted from bootstrap data in which this thread's unread is still 1 (app.js:113-121). catchUp then appends the message, and markRead() zeroes a.unread but re-renders only the thread-list row (threads.js:100-109, 157). Nothing repaints the nav total. It is corrected only after POST /read broadcasts 'changed', the 300 ms liveUpdate debounce elapses and another bootstrap is fetched (app.js:133-136). So for about 300-350 ms after the message becomes visible, the displayed total is one too high. The functional prompt's timed observation polls the DOM every 500 ms until the expected change (the message) is present. A judge that reads the total in that same detecting poll lands inside the stale window most of the time. The scripted harness only asserted server-side unread after sleep(500) (workspace.cjs:459-460) and never the displayed total at arrival, so this leg is unmeasured for the golden. Lessons check: lessons 7 and 14 (timing races fail correct apps) apply exactly here. Lesson 8 (modifier clicks) is not triggered because the golden selects with checkboxes. Lesson 15 (restart): the golden keeps everything across a restart without reseeding, so all of D's re-reads hold. Lesson 19: the golden harness is not extended to every criterion leg (e.g. job-open refusals through the UI, the Activity filter and Show more, the nav total). Notes, not blocking: (a) Protocol U says 'Move Tomas's page off that conversation (to his applications list)'. When the 'My applications' nav button is clicked, the golden candidate view keeps the open conversation on screen (setView -> shown() keeps openId, threads.js:215-220). The judge must reload or open his other conversation; otherwise Rafael's next message is marked seen at once and hro_seen's 'shows as not seen' leg would fail. (b) Undo Activity lines read 'X undid a move: N is back in Screen' (index.js:366), naming only the destination stage. This is plausible under hro_activity, but a strict judge could want from and to stages. (c) Activity shows 50 lines and then a 'Show more' button, which the judge must click on long J2 histories.
counterexample: Rafael has Tomas's J2 conversation open at its newest message, and the nav total is N. Tomas sends one message. About 300 ms later, Rafael's bootstrap refresh paints the nav 'Conversations' badge as N+1. catchUp then appends the message and clears only the row badge. The nav badge stays at N+1 until the next debounced refresh, about 300 ms or more later. The judge's 500 ms poll that first sees the message, reading the total in the same evaluate, records N+1. hro_unread_counts (weight 2) then scores 0 for the reference, so Oracle falls below 1.0. Derived from the frozen source; not exercised in any run.
suggested_fix: In the golden, repaint the nav unread total whenever threads markRead() or open() zeroes a thread locally (e.g. expose a badge-repaint helper from app.js render() and call it from markRead), or paint the nav badge only after catchUp resolves. Then extend the scripted golden harness to assert the displayed total at the moment the message appears, and add a golden-run check of protocol U's 'move Tomas's page off that conversation' step.
